handlers.name: ActorType08_09_PlayerCollisionHandler
handlers.semantics: Directional terrain-push response selected by actor/player X ordering. The handler consumes the right/left push latches, publishes the response code and transition latches, and applies the corresponding stop flag only when vertical motion and active terrain response do not suppress it.

handlers.name: ActorType03_PlayerCollisionHandler
handlers.semantics: Ungated shared collision recovery, otherwise source conversion to type 0x84 with animation 0x00122E16 and linked interaction-byte clear.

handlers.name: ActorType2F_PlayerCollisionHandler
handlers.semantics: Type-0x84 response animation install with ungated interaction recovery; gated contacts can queue event 0x21 and allocate a backward-slot Type-0x84 companion from 0x001B7E40, copying source X/Y.

handlers.name: ActorType30_PlayerCollisionHandler
handlers.semantics: Optional interaction recovery followed by source resource cleanup, ACTOR_TEMPLATE_DEATH_84 reload, and response animation 0x00123024.

boundary_checks.result: Each promoted body ends immediately before the next table entry or existing canonical handler, with no overlapping owned bytes.

conclusion: The seven entries are now canonicalized. They add directional terrain-push and type-0x84 response/companion semantics to the collision model, while the no-op and direct interaction delegates are explicitly separated. None writes the missing Level 01 vertical transfer state directly.
